autoresearch_campaign: Create or update one autonomous research campaign combining investigation and remote experiments.
Use the conversation to establish the objective and only unresolved high-level questions.
Do not ask the user for repository commits, datasets, commands or image digests. The campaign discovers them.
Do not create a separate deep-research proposal for the same campaign. Inspect existing plans first and
supply id and revision to update or migrate a legacy draft. Clear questions when answers are known.
Timezone defaults to the user's settings. Express an explicit deadline as an ISO timestamp with offset.
Creating the campaign does not start it. Start requires a subsequent user confirmation or Start button.
autoresearch_result: Read the campaign's saved report in bounded pages. Follow nextOffset for the full result.
Distinguish measured experiment results from unverified findings and proposed experiments.
autoresearch_status: Read autonomous campaigns and exact experiment manifest plans in this Slack thread.
Read before proposing or controlling an experiment plan. Follow nextOffset for older plans.
Campaign state and remote connection status are separate. Configured does not mean successfully connected.
autoresearch_propose: Prepare a legacy exact experiment manifest. Prefer autoresearch_campaign for autonomous investigation.
Include only verified repository revisions, datasets, evaluation criteria and budgets.
Leave unresolved fields absent. Use a campaign when these details should be discovered autonomously.
Existing plans require both id and revision. This never accesses a remote server or runs commands.
autoresearch_control: Start, pause, resume, cancel or refresh an autonomous campaign using its current id and revision.
Start only after the user confirms the prepared campaign in a later message. Resume retains its deadline.
For legacy manifest plans, approve saves the manifest only.
Approve only after the user confirms an existing complete plan in a later message. Approval saves an
immutable execution manifest and does not start, queue or schedule an experiment. Refresh restores the
status message. The legacy experiment runner is not configured.
autoresearch_manifest: Read the saved execution manifest for a prepared experiment plan in this thread. Follow nextOffset
for additional chunks. A manifest describes intended work, not executed or verified experiment results.
